# Daily Report — 2026-07-27

## Task Completed
Added `list_workflow_activities` tool (`sys_hub_action_type_base` table). When a
`flow_id` is provided the tool resolves the Flow Designer flow's application scope
and filters action types to that scope; without `flow_id` it lists all matching
action types across the instance. Filters: `name` (substring), `category` (exact),
`active` (bool), `flow_id` (sys_id or name substring). Full pagination support
with `has_more`/`next_offset`. Registered in `platform_developer` and `full`
packages.
